verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing describes a built-in AI you can query: you can "Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap" and the AI "surfaces answers, automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports." The pricing page adds "Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data," and Rippling claims it can act on device telemetry before a ticket is filed. Together these cover in-product AI insights and suggested actions drawn from the customer's own data. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the AI insights and suggestions work (scope, data sources, proactive recommendations versus on-demand Q&A), and any independent or hands-on confirmation beyond marketing pages.
